svg.aria-label: A Base dashboard: stats, a bubble chart, tasks and a calendar over one Base
svg.text: One Base, many panels — a local Grafana for your vault
Focus: hours × mood, sized by deep-work blocks
One Base is the datasource: the count is what its filters select, and every panel reads the same notes.
Eleven chart types — stat, bar, line, area, scatter, bubble, pie, donut, table, heatmap, calendar — and Tasks.
A Tasks panel ticks a box in the note: the one thing a dashboard ever writes.
Colours come from your Obsidian theme and repaint when you switch light or dark.
